title: Intent frontmatter
description: The frontmatter of .sdlc/intents/<id>.md. The body carries the problem; this carries only what a machine routes on.

type.description: solution starts a new codebase; suggestion originates from a verify document.

stack.description: Present only when this intent departs from the solution's declared stack.

source.description: For type suggestion: the verify document this came from.

accepted_by.description: The person who accepted this artifact. Written by them, not by a skill: it is the gate.

accepted_at.description: When it was accepted. Required alongside accepted_by - a name with no date says nothing about which version was accepted.

allOf.description: Acceptance is both fields or neither.
